第 23 章 Engineering Productivity工程生产力

Camille Fournier / 卡米尔·福尼耶

— 第 71 页 —

I'm often asked about the characteristics of great engineering managers. This is a question that almost always has a long answer that involves, "Well, she's good at X, and he's good at Y, and then there's Z…" Every management role is slightly different, and a great engineering team will have managers who reflect a set of complementary skill sets (such as operations, people management and coaching, and product focus) that are aligned with what their sub-group most needs.

经常有人问我优秀工程经理的特征是什么。这个问题的答案几乎总是很长，涉及「她擅长 X，他擅长 Y，还有 Z……」每个管理角色都略有不同，一个优秀的工程团队会有反映互补技能组合（如运维、人员管理和辅导、产品关注）的经理，与他们子团队最需要的东西对齐。

However, for most of us, there is one characteristic that is not optional or debatable, which is that a great engineering manager is capable of creating a highly productive engineering team. This is one of the distinguishing characteristics of the management side of engineering. Call it what you will — drive for results, goal oriented — if you are not great at getting your team to be productive, this is a critical growth opportunity.

然而，对我们大多数人来说，有一个特征不是可选或可争议的，那就是优秀的工程经理有能力创建一个高生产力的工程团队。这是工程管理侧的区别性特征之一。随你怎么叫它——结果驱动、目标导向——如果你不擅长让团队高效，这是一个关键的成长机会。

How do I know this is important? Ask any engineering manager at a startup what one of their most dreaded questions is, and they will almost certainly mention "why isn't it done yet?" Engineering productivity is a difficult thing to measure, but most of us know intuitively what it feels like to be on a productive team. We're shipping things, we're focused, we feel like we know what we're doing and why it is important.

我怎么知道这很重要？问任何创业公司的工程经理他们最怕的问题之一是什么，他们几乎肯定会提到「为什么还没做完？」工程生产力很难衡量，但我们大多数人直觉上知道在高效团队里是什么感觉。我们在交付东西，我们专注，我们觉得自己知道在做什么以及为什么重要。

So, what are the management skills that are needed to achieve this result? At the first level of management, they look like:

那么，实现这个结果需要什么管理技能？在第一层管理，它们看起来是：

  • Breaking down the scope of projects to help your team ship frequently. An eye for the Minimum Viable Product (MVP), for sequencing work, and for predicting likely risks and bottlenecks for project completion are the skills here. This is why I think project management is such an important part of engineering leadership development and why I hate to hand it off to professional project managers for work that doesn't cross teams or organizations.拆解项目范围以帮助团队频繁交付。这里的技能包括对最小可行产品（MVP）的眼光、对工作排序的判断、以及预测项目完成可能的风险和瓶颈。这就是为什么我认为项目管理是工程领导发展如此重要的一部分，也是为什么我不愿意把不跨团队或组织的工作交给专业项目经理。
— 第 72 页 —
  • Balancing product delivery with sustainable engineering so that you don't end up with code that can't be maintained in the future. The amount you will invest here depends on the future certainty (baby startup? Probably not so much!), but there's a reason we call it "technical debt" and that is because it inevitably comes due, unless you declare bankruptcy.平衡产品交付和可持续工程，以免最终得到未来无法维护的代码。你在这里投资多少取决于未来的确定性（婴儿期创业公司？可能不需要那么多！），但我们叫它「技术债」是有原因的——因为它不可避免地会到期，除非你宣布破产。
  • Prioritizing, prioritizing, prioritizing. Implicit in the first two skills is the ability to figure out what is important and prioritize it. If you overprioritize shipping, you might get a lot done for a while and then slow down as the debt you've accumulated comes due. Overprioritize sustaining engineering and you don't ship product. You might not start out with these instincts, but they can be developed, so don't be afraid to start making judgment calls now and learning from the results.优先级、优先级、还是优先级。前两个技能隐含的是搞清楚什么重要并排序的能力。如果你过度优先交付，你可能短期内做了很多，然后随着累积的技术债到期而慢下来。过度优先维护工程，你就不交付产品。你可能一开始没有这些直觉，但它们可以培养，所以不要害怕现在就开始做判断并从结果中学习。

Managers who fail in these three areas quickly show why this is such an important skill set. Teams that don't ship are usually disengaged and rarely get the positive feedback of seeing their work come to fruition. Teams that don't ever clean up their tech debt end up burning out from the difficulty of supporting their software and the challenges of building new features. And when teams don't prioritize effectively, they end up burning cycles on things that are ultimately not that important, which often contributes to a sense of purposelessness.

在这三个方面失败的经理很快就会显示出为什么这是如此重要的技能组合。不交付的团队通常是 disengaged 的，很少看到工作成果的正面反馈。从不清理技术债的团队最终因为维护软件的困难和构建新功能的挑战而倦怠。当团队不能有效排优先级时，他们最终在最终不那么重要的事情上浪费周期，这往往导致无目的感。

This is not the only thing that is important in engineering management, but without a focus on delivery, you are letting your team down in a critical way. So, while you're learning how to have good one-on-ones, listen to people, create psychologically safe teams, and think about people's careers; don't forget that if your team isn't shipping, you're not doing your job. Nurturing a safe and healthy team helps them do their best work, and helping them identify and deliver that best work is a key part of keeping them healthy.

这不是工程管理中唯一重要的事情，但如果不关注交付，你就是在关键方面辜负了团队。所以，当你学习如何做好一对一、倾听人们、创造心理安全的团队、思考人们的职业发展时；不要忘记如果你的团队不交付，你就没在做你的工作。培养安全健康的团队帮他们做最好的工作，帮他们识别和交付那最好的工作是保持他们健康的关键部分。
